desc:
Master the art of Hajwala drifting.

USE CODE "FAST" FOR $50K
Please leave a like 👍 to get money by CODES! 
(new code at 30,000 likes!!)

Drift powerful cars across massive desert highways inspired by Middle Eastern street drifting culture. Link insane drifts, cruise with convoys, and become the king of the road.

Controls:
(PC): WASD to drive cars
Hold shift + W+A+D to drift 
Hold F to go on 2 wheels

(MOBILE) Arrows to drift
Hold the tilted car button to go on 2 wheels
Hold the accelerator button to move forward
Hold the brake pedal to move back or stop

More controls in-game!

💰 Earn cash by drifting and doing stunts
🏁  Realistic highway drifting physics
🌵 Massive desert highway map
🏆 Multiplayer convoys and climb the leaderboards
🚗 Buy and drift cars
🎮 Mobile, XBOX, PS5, and PC support
